name: PLANETARY BALL MILL
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-PBM-8L Planetary Ball Mill is a high-energy milling machine used extensively in nanotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and materials science. It is engineered to pulverize, mix, and mechanically alloy powders and slurries down to the sub-micron or nano level (particle size below 1 µm). This machine handles soft, medium-hard, very hard, brittle, and fibrous samples in either dry or wet mode.
features: Particle size below 1 µm achievable (material dependent)
Color touch screen programmable controller (forward, reverse, pause)
Variable speed with VFD controller up to 870 rpm (model dependent)
Dual clamping holds jars firmly and safely during high-speed operation
Heavy-duty gear and belt drive built for long, trouble-free operation

specifications.Feed Size: ≤10 mm for soft/brittle material, ≤3 mm for hard material
specifications.Output Size: Minimum output particle size <1 µm (material dependent)
specifications.Speed Range: 40 rpm up to 870 rpm (Depending on model volume)
specifications.Jars & Balls Materials: Stainless Steel 304, Zirconia, Alumina, Tungsten Carbide, Agate, PTFE/PU
specifications.Target Applications: Battery research, Nanotech, Ceramics, Geology, Pharmaceuticals
